newsitem.title: GERMANY: Oilmeal output rise forecast for 97/98 - Oil World.
newsitem.headline: Oilmeal output rise forecast for 97/98 - Oil World.

text.p: Active seed crushings in the 1997/98 (October/September) campaign should boost the production of oilmeals, the independent Oil World newsletter said on Tuesday.
It forecast global output of 12 oilmeals in October/September 1997/98 at 178.2 million tonnes, up from 169.8 million in 1996/97.

Oil World, which in a separate forecast put 1997/98 oilseeds output at 276 million tonnes -- up from 257 million previously -- said processing activity in the new season should be mostly driven by demand for vegetable oils.
World production of soybean meal would rise by nearly seven million tonnes to 97.4 million in 1997/98, due to increases in the Americas, China, India, Europe, Mexico and others.
But world production of fishmeal, which has been declining since May, in 1997/98 might stagnate at, or fall below, the 6.2 million tonnes estimated for 1996/97.
Chilean and Peruvian fish stocks had started moving away from the traditional fishing zones, where the El Nino weather phenomenon was warming up the water.
